Play tip · Chapter 2

Work around Moses' sales cooldown

After each sale Moses' garage shuts briefly. PowerPyx and GTABase put the wait at roughly two real-time minutes, and the practical rhythm is to steal the next car during the cooldown so he is open when you return. Be aware gta6.house and Game Rant instead describe a few in-game hours between sales and a daily sales limit — either way, car-flipping is steady money, not fast money.
